It does not explicitly rely on or test those claims, though it could be loosely motivated by them (the high-T failure suggesting a low-T effect). Claim 5 mentions the high-T regime as somewhat stronger for a different feature, which is a different feature altogether.

The hypothesis is a fresh one. It is not the smoothed contrast between hours and wage, and it is not the stock-versus-flow contrast. It has no explicit dependence on the claims, so I judge that it does not use any of them.
